scope: Optional exact revision through the existing Model download lifecycle; controlled source-selection evidence only
evidence_policy: Current candidate-bound executed receipts and separate independent review govern component completion. This document is neither an executed receipt nor a parent pass.
controls: Both synchronous and asynchronous pinned starts require the same current worker to advertise ensure-model-download.exact-revision-v1 before task dispatch. Copied targets and worker ownership remain current through that preflight, preventing an older worker from silently acquiring a floating head.
Optional revisions are strict forty-lowercase-hex repository commits. Omission preserves ordinary request and completion wire fields.
Both application download paths propagate the captured revision. Worker confirmation must match the exact model and requested revision before registration; request intent alone is not provenance.

The runtime client detaches pinned inputs before transport awaits and validates confirmation. The worker selects that revision for cache and transfer, verifies the exact host-owned repository snapshot and returns a fixed non-retryable mismatch error without deletion, floating fallback, alias replacement or hidden retry.

Existing runtime authentication, ownership, byte/file/format guards, deadlines, task completion authority and ordinary retry/cancellation behavior remain authoritative. No loading or offload guard changes.

The fixed worker profile retains its existing Context cases and adds only the controlled revision class; Node/strict-type checks retain related Model and runtime-client compatibility. Unknown sources and explicitly requested generic checks retain fallback.
controlled_observations: Eleven Python fixture cases exercise actual request/result schemas, passive protocol advertisement, snapshot-selection functions, the app completion wrapper and authenticated in-process HTTP serialization using mocked provider returns and disposable synthetic files; no real weights, transfer or inference occurred.

Focused Model contract/application and HTTP-client cases exercised exact propagation, old-worker/mismatched confirmation denial, detached awaited targets and ordinary behavior. Current candidate-bound checks determine their final result.
Expanded strict checking exposed pre-existing untyped callback parameters and one deliberately padded tag fixture; explicit annotations preserve their runtime assertions.

Source review identified that confirmation alone occurred too late for an older worker that could ignore a pin. The added versioned capability preflight refuses before task dispatch, with direct async and synchronous client tests for absent support, captured inputs and replaced worker ownership.

qualification_limits: Snapshot path/revision confirmation proves source selection, not immutable file contents, supplier authenticity, license rights, model compatibility, resources or quality.
No real provider download, model load, training, generation, native cleanup, actual Desktop/Managed host or parent/package/final-roadmap qualification is supplied by these fixtures.
No new public Headless acquisition operation or effect approval is exposed. Approved source/format/license inspection and scoped task/status integration remain I7 work.
Accepted ordinary model accuracy and current memory/offload/security limits remain unchanged.
